faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: The rise and catastrophic fall of the civilizations of ancient Egypt.
kurzfassung: This episode explores the history of the civilizations of ancient Egypt along the Nile Valley. It examines how these cultures developed in the river floodplains and constructed iconic structures. Finally, it tells the story of the events that brought the age of the Pharaohs to an end.
stichpunkte: Journey to the Nile Valley to explore ancient Egyptian cultures
Development of civilizations in the great river's floodplains
Construction of some of the world's most enduring and recognizable structures
The events that brought the age of the Pharaohs to a catastrophic end
beschreibung: Far in the distance, three colossal shapes tower over the desert horizon…In this episode, we travel to the Nile Valley, and tell the story of one of the most iconic cultures ever produced by humankind – the civilizations of ancient Egypt. I want to show how this series of related cultures grew up in the floodplains of their great river, and built some of the most enduring and recognizable structures in the world. And I want to tell the story of what happened to bring the age of the Pharaohs finally and cataclysmically to an end.
